requested_by: Tan, 2026-10-07, during the GPU session: run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash with the same setup after the first three models finish
launch_flags: common deployment only; parsers qwen3/qwen3_xml and glm45/glm47 as in the historical launches; Qwen thinking off with enable_thinking=false; a model-specific flag is added only if the common launch fails, and is then recorded as a deviation
known_limits: The two models are measured after the first three, in the same session; model order is not rotated across all five, so slow drift of the node is confounded with the group.
Counts were sized on the first three models. If an added model is faster than the fastest of them at a point, its window can be shorter than 60 s; the window is reported, not hidden.
The historical GLM and Qwen results in references/ used other builds, utilization and prefix settings; they are not controls for these runs.
budget: estimated 2.3 additional node-hours: two diagnostic launches and six timing launches
deviations_declared_before_running: GLM-5.3-Flash cannot run with thinking off: its chat template always opens the assistant turn with <think> and offers only reasoning_effort low/high/max. It runs with reasoning_effort=low. Forced 256-token timing is unaffected in step count, but the generated tokens are reasoning text and the natural-EOS functional check is expected to show reasoning content.
